Grace / Jordan — quick legal read: I opened the UK-IDTA-draft-redlines.pdf and flagged three clauses that need explicit confirmation from Starnex if we are to accept their proposed custody carve-out:
1) "Limited custody" must be scoped to processing activities and exclude long-term archival key escrow.
2) We need a rollback mechanism for export of keys if jurisdictional access events occur.
3) SLA credits for any failure of the limited-custody commitment (narrow definition) must be capped (suggest cap = 3 months revenue).

Operational ask for Jordan: can Product Ops produce redacted per-subprocessor log samples with the following fields: timestamp, actor-id, action-type, resource-id, and retention tag? Also include a short README describing sample method and redaction rules. We should stage samples in the Drive folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-starnex-evidence).

I'll prepare a proposed UK-IDTA rider that contains the limited-custody language and the rollback procedure. Attaching a working PDF of redlines for your review.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
(attachment: UK-IDTA-draft-redlines.pdf)
